plugins.name: corporate-legal
plugins.description: Runs M&A diligence at scale with cited tabular review, builds disclosure schedules and closing checklists, drafts board consents and minutes in house format, and tracks entity compliance deadlines across jurisdictions.

skills.name: ai-tool-handoff
skills.description: Detects when Luminance, Kira, or a similar bulk-review tool is in use, hands off the high-volume clause extraction to it, and QAs its output per the trust level in `~/.claude/plugins/config/claude-for-legal/corporate-legal/CLAUDE.md`. Use when user says "send to Luminance", "bulk review", "AI extraction", or when diligence-issue-extraction hits a high-volume category.
headings: Close with the next-steps decision tree
What this skill does not do
skills.description_zh: 识别Luminance、Kira等批量审查工具的使用，将大量条款提取交给工具，并按团队公司法实践档案规定的信任级别复核输出。

skills.name: board-minutes
skills.description: Drafts board or committee meeting minutes in your house format. Auto-detects upcoming board and committee meetings from your calendar, asks for the agenda and any slides or pre-read materials, and produces a complete draft in the format learned from your seed minutes. Also handles written consents in lieu of meetings. Trigger: "board minutes", "draft minutes", "upcoming board meeting", "committee minutes", "written consent", or calendar detection of an upcoming board or committee event.
headings: What this skill does not do
skills.description_zh: 按团队格式起草董事会或委员会会议纪要，从日历识别近期会议、索取议程与预读材料，并沿用样例纪要格式，也支持代替会议的书面同意。

skills.name: closing-checklist
skills.description: What's blocking close — maintain the closing checklist with status, critical path, and days to close. Self-updating: ingests new items from diligence findings and schedule builds, tracks status, surfaces what's blocking. Use when user says "closing checklist", "what's left to close", "checklist status", "add to the checklist", or on a scheduled status pull.
headings: Mode 1: Initialize from the purchase agreement
What this skill does not do
skills.description_zh: 维护交易交割清单、状态、关键路径和距交割天数，从尽调发现与附表编制吸收新事项，指出阻碍交割的问题，并支持定期状态汇总。

skills.name: cold-start-interview
skills.description: House cold-start interview (request list + prior memo), or --new-deal for deal-specific context. Modular: identifies which practice areas apply (M&A, Board & Secretary, Public Company, Entity Management), then asks targeted questions for each active module and writes only the relevant sections to the plugin config. Use on fresh install, when CLAUDE.md still has [PLACEHOLDER] markers, when starting a new deal, or to re-check integrations or refresh a module.
headings: Check for the shared company profile
After the user picks quick or full
Part 0: Who's using this, and what's connected
Part 2M: M&A module (4–6 min, if active)
Part 2B: Board & Secretary module (3–4 min, if active)
Part 2P: Public Company module (3–4 min, if active)
Part 2E: Entity Management module (2–3 min, if active)
skills.description_zh: 通过初始访谈或新交易访谈配置公司法实践，识别并购、董事会秘书、上市公司及实体管理模块，仅写入相关配置，也可重新检查集成或刷新模块。

skills.name: customize
skills.description: Guided customization of your corporate practice profile — change one thing without re-running the whole cold-start interview. Adjust risk posture, escalation contacts, active modules (M&A / Board / Public Company / Entity Management), materiality thresholds, disclosure schedule format, consent precedents, or matter workspace paths. Use when the user says "change my [thing]", "update my profile", "edit my config", or "customize".
skills.description_zh: 逐项调整公司法实践档案，包括风险偏好、升级联系人、启用模块、重要性阈值、披露附表格式、同意先例与事项工作区路径，无需重做完整访谈。

skills.name: deal-team-summary
skills.description: Aggregate diligence findings into a deal team briefing at the right altitude for the audience — exec summary for leadership, working summary for the team. Use when user says "brief the deal team", "what's the state of diligence", "summarize findings for [audience]", "deal update", or on the briefing cadence.
skills.description_zh: 将尽调发现汇总为适合受众的交易团队简报，为管理层提供执行摘要，为工作团队提供详细工作摘要，并支持定期更新。

skills.name: diligence-issue-extraction
skills.description: Read VDR documents and extract issues per house categories and materiality thresholds, producing findings in house memo format. Use when user says "review the data room", "extract issues from [folder]", "diligence review", "what's in the VDR", or points at VDR documents.
headings: Close with the next-steps decision tree
What this skill does not do
skills.description_zh: 读取虚拟数据室文档，按团队问题类别和重要性阈值提取尽调事项，以团队备忘录格式输出发现。

skills.name: entity-compliance
skills.description: Entity compliance tracker — initialize, report upcoming deadlines, update status, run health audit, export to CSV. Maintains a compliance-tracker.yaml built from the entity table, calculates filing deadlines by entity and jurisdiction, and surfaces what's due in the next 30/60/90 days. Use when user says "entity compliance", "filing deadlines", "annual reports due", "entity tracker", "what filings are due", "entity health", or "good standing".
headings: Disclaimer: deadlines are reference only — confirm with registered agent or Secretary of State
Step 2: For each entity × jurisdiction, confirm the filing requirements
skills.description_zh: 从实体表建立并维护合规跟踪YAML，按实体与司法辖区计算申报期限，报告未来30、60、90天事项、更新状态、开展健康审查并导出CSV。

skills.name: integration-management
skills.description: Post-closing M&A integration tracker — phased workplan, consent tracking, contract assignment at scale, weekly status reports. Initializes from whatever deal artifacts are available (purchase agreement, deal summary, closing checklist) and connects to deal-context.md and closing-checklist.yaml from the M&A cold-start. Use when user says "integration", "post-close", "post-closing", "consents outstanding", "contract assignment", "integration status", or "what's left on the deal".
headings: What this skill does not do
skills.description_zh: 跟踪并购交割后整合，依据采购协议、交易摘要或交割清单初始化分阶段计划，管理同意事项、批量合同转让及周度状态，并连接交易上下文与交割清单。

skills.name: material-contract-schedule
skills.description: Build the material contracts disclosure schedule from diligence findings, applying the purchase agreement's Material Contract definition and formatting per the agreement's schedule format. Use when user says "build the contracts schedule", "disclosure schedule", "schedule 3.X", "material contracts list", or when drafting disclosure schedules.
headings: Step 2: Apply the definition to the findings
What this skill does not do
skills.description_zh: 根据尽调发现和收购协议的重要合同定义建立合同披露附表，并采用协议规定的附表格式。

skills.name: matter-workspace
skills.description: Manage matter workspaces — create, list, switch, close, or detach the active matter so multi-client practitioners keep one client's context separate from every other. Read by any substantive skill that needs to know what matter it's working in. Use when user says "new matter", "switch matter", "list matters", "close matter", or wants to work at practice-level only.
headings: Active matter is in the practice CLAUDE.md
skills.description_zh: 创建、列出、切换、关闭或脱离当前法律事项工作区，帮助多客户执业者隔离各客户上下文，并为实务技能提供当前事项信息。

skills.name: tabular-review
skills.description: Tabular review — one row per document, one column per data point, every cell cited to source. Built for M&A diligence ("review these 200 target contracts for change-of-control, assignment, and MAC clauses") but works for any batch review that needs a spreadsheet out the other end. Use when user says "tabular review", "review grid", "build a grid", "extract these fields from these contracts", "review these documents for X, Y, Z", "give me a spreadsheet of", "batch review", or points at a folder of documents and asks to compare them.
headings: Step 1: Build and confirm the schema
Close with the next-steps decision tree
What this skill does not do
skills.description_zh: 对批量文档进行表格审查，每份文档一行、每个提取字段一列、每个单元格附来源引用，适用于并购合同条款提取、文档比较与电子表格输出。

skills.name: written-consent
skills.description: Draft a unanimous written consent of the board or a committee in house format, with precedent search from the consents repository. Handles multi-resolution consents, director conflict flags, state-law notice requirements, and signatory tracking, with a built-in scope warning for major one-off actions. Use when user says "written consent", "unanimous consent", "board consent", "consent in lieu", "UWC", or describes an action needing board approval without a meeting.
headings: Step 4: Confirm the consent rules for the state of incorporation
What this skill does not do
skills.description_zh: 按团队格式和同意文件先例起草董事会或委员会一致书面同意，处理多项决议、董事利益冲突、州法通知要求和签署人跟踪，并提示重大一次性行动的范围。
